## Diagnosis Summary

Root cause: Container command `exit 1` causes immediate crash.

### Root Cause
The container is configured with `command: ["sh", "-c", "exit 1"]` which exits immediately with code 1, triggering CrashLoopBackOff.

### Remediation
```bash
kubectl delete pod crashloop-test-pod -n test-ns
```

Or fix the command:
```bash
kubectl patch pod crashloop-test-pod -n test-ns --type='merge' -p='{"spec":{"containers":[{"name":"crash","command":["sh","-c","sleep infinity"]}]}}'
```

### Risk Level
Low — test pod with no dependencies.

### Verification
```bash
kubectl get pod crashloop-test-pod -n test-ns
```
